status: Cached shaping reused for layout extent changes; GPI-S2 remains in progress
selection: TextBufferCache treated width/height changes as full buffer misses and repeated Buffer creation/set_text or set_rich_text, even with identical text/font/style. Existing cosmic-text public Buffer clone and set_size preserve cached ShapeLine data while recalculating layout.
production_paths: Shared TextBufferCache::indices -> ensure_text_buffer in full-frame and dialog-only glyph preparation
competing_paths_retired: Unconditional fresh shaping buffer for every layout-extent miss
change: One cache scan finds an exact layout hit or a matching shape source. On extent-only miss, clone the existing public Buffer cache and relayout at the new extent; only missing text/font/style creates a fresh buffer. Key and frame/entry/key-byte retention semantics remain. Tests moved to an owned child module to satisfy inline-tail source limits; no legacy ceiling raised.
fixed_profile: The current renderer loads its font inventory at creation; FontSystem locale/language fallback stays within that owner. Face supplies family/weight/letter spacing; size supplies font/line metrics; shaping is Basic, with existing default wrap/alignment/features. This slice does not introduce configurable language/direction/features or complete future full-key requirements.
bounds: No new cache or enlarged budget. Existing entries retain each layout variant under the same workspace two-generation and overlay 128-entry/32-KiB-key limits. Buffer cloning copies cached payload; it is not zero-allocation or shared-payload deduplication.

proof.cpu: Actual font/shape cache: multiple widths produce identical complete glyph debug data and line coordinates/widths to fresh buffers. Two extent variants reuse shape caches; return width and translated clip hit layout cache; size/rich-style changes do not reuse incompatible shape sources.
proof.negative: Disabling cross-extent shape-source reuse fails the CPU reuse assertion. Mutated source restored byte-for-byte; final suite/GPU/lint/release built restored source.
proof.gpu: Actual dialog captures at four width steps match forced-fresh shaped-cache pixels on Intel P630/Vulkan. Existing shared atlas retry/failure/reindex GPU regression passes.
proof.native: Final release X11 MAIN zoom-in/out and GLOBAL/PROJECT/NEW startup/presentation/close smoke pass with exit zero. No native shape-count or resize qualification claim.
proof.build_lint: Offline guarded release and renderer library/tests Clippy pass.
proof.governance: Source health, dependency authority, parity, traceability/spec/project, diff and staged rustfmt pass. Initial inline-test-tail gate was resolved through the real child test module, without a ceiling change.
proof.app_scope: No app source changes or full app suite rerun; known terminal lineage/convergence issues remain open.

limits: Public Buffer cloning preserves already-shaped paragraphs; newly revealed unshaped paragraphs may still shape. No zero-total-shaping, zero-allocation or numerical performance claim.
Font/language/direction/features key qualification, full shaped-payload/atlas/scratch accounting and caps remain open.
Native boundary counters, prescribed full per-adapter negatives, backend/scale/endurance and complete S2 acceptance remain open.
No third-party modifications, downloads, dependencies, versions/licenses, visual prototypes, shaping policy/typography, product mutation or resize qualification changes.
